column1: Experimental data Illing et al "Critical thermal maxima of early life stages of tropical fishes"
Species=Amphiprion melanopus, Acanthochromis polyacanthus, Lates calcarifer
Time_load=time when test subject was loaded into the trial (24h format)
Time_end=time when test subject lost equilibrium (LOE)
Acc_time=time that test subject spent in beaker before heating started
M1-3= separate measurements of snout to end of notochord length in mm (standard length, SL)
BW_centred_all=dry weight minus overall mean dry weight
CS and LDH=enzyme activities in µmol min-1 mg protein-1
